title: Will Dopamine Chamber by Fontaines D.C. have above 10000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026 tracking week? Above 10K
rules: If Dopamine Chamber by Fontaines D.C. has above 10K Album Equivalent Units during the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Dopamine Chamber's release on Oct 16, 2026 makes the Oct 16-22 window its first week. The previous album, Romance, debuted at No. 97 on the Billboard 200 in 2024, which I estimate was roughly 8-10K US units, so it was near this threshold. The band has grown since then (UK first-week sales doubled, Grammy nominations, a Rosalía feature, vinyl first-pressing pre-orders), so a debut above 10K seems more likely than not. It is far from certain because the US audience is still modest.
blind.falsifier: Luminate reports Dopamine Chamber at 10,000 or fewer US album-equivalent units for the Oct 16-22, 2026 week, for example a debut in the lower half of the Billboard 200 or below it.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.81 is above my 0.70; it may reflect first-week projections I couldn't find, so I move to 0.75. Selling at the 0.77 bid gives only a 2-point edge, too thin given the wide spread and uncertainty about Romance's US baseline.
